requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Get started with Memotto"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memotto is a note-taking app that can bring together text, tables, and images into one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "In this guide, we will use examples from Yamanashi-san in PR and Takanashi-san in Sales."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "A short note added to a page is called a 'Quick Note'."}, {"id":1, "text": "Yamanashi-san has left meeting decisions as Quick Notes."}, {"id":2, "text": "Yamanashi-san has placed Sticky notes on important parts as markers."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Each page can have up to ten items."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "For teams to use"}, {"id":1, "text": "Takanashi's sales team first created a Space."}, {"id":2, "text": "A place that everyone can see within a Space is called a 'Commons'."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "In the Commons, anyone can post notes."}, {"id":1, "text": "Takanashi shares his sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id":2, "text": "You can invite members to a Space via email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Invited people will receive a confirmation email."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once approved by the administrator, you can join immediately."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed per space."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and Revisions"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit offline, and it will sync as soon as you connect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "From the page's Revisions, you can revert to a previous state."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tsukimisato recovered the text she accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Tips for organization"}, {"id":1, "text": "It is convenient to pin important pages."}, {"id":2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It is easier to find notes in the plaza if you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Kotori-san divides tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "The same tag can be used for a brief note."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In search, you can look for both tags and short notes at the same time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "If you can't find it, try broadening your search scope."}]}
